tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (257)༄༅/ /slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i phyi chos mdo sngags thun mong gi lam rim rin chen spungs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/
(257)༄༅/ /slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i phyi chos mdo sngags thun mong gi lam rim rin chen spungs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: (257)༄༅// slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i phyi chos mdo sngags thun mong gi lam rim rin chen spungs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(258)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ shes bya'i yul la rnam par brtag /thar pa'i lam la rab zhugs te// 'bras bu rnam mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// rin chen spungs pa bstan par bya/ ༈ mtshan nyid brgyud pa ldan zhing gdams ngag che// dbang dang ldan zhing byin rlabs che// shes rab ldan zhing snying rje che// thos pa ldan zhing nyams myong che// lta ba ldan zhing sgom gyis zin// tshig la mkhas shing don la gnas// zhes pa ste/ "$ drug ldan bla ma ni/ 'du shes bzhi la thun mong*/ khyad par/ yang dag /log pa'i 'du shes bzhi/ de re re la'ang bzhi bzhi ste/ dang po la/ 'khor ba chu bo// chos gru/ bla ma mnyan pa/ nyams len chu brgal ba'i tshul lo// gnyis pa la rang nad pa/ bla ma sman pa/ chos la sman/ nyams len nad gso ba'i 'du shes so// gsum pa la/ rang dug lnga'i nad kyis zin pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas/ gdams ngag bdud rtsi/ nyams len dug lnga sel ba'i 'du shes/ bzhi pa la/ rang rgyal po/ bla ma tshong pa/ chos tshong zong*/ nyan bshad tshong gi 'du shes te/ de rnams las phyi ma bzhi spang la/ snga ma rnams dang*/ lda na pa'i dran pas bstan/ snod kyi skyon kha sbubs// zhabs brdol/ dug can/ gsum spangs (259) la bsnyen// mthong lugs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba/ dpe nor bu/ don sangs rgyas las kyang lhag par blta ba ste/ sangs rgyas lnga ldan sgo nas blta// dal 'byor mi lus rin po che: shin tu rnyed dka' thob dus su: don med stong log ma byed par: gtan gyi so nam da res kyis: phyi yi mi rtag dbyar dgun1/ dus 2bzhi/ nyin 3mtshan/ skye 'gags gnas 4gsum rgyu zag pa 5dang ma zad pa yang mi rtag pa ste/ rnam pa lnga: nang gi mi rtag nges 1par 'chi/ nam 'chi'i cha 2med/ 'chi ba'i tshe cis kyang3 mi stongs ba ste/ rnam pa gsum: tshul cis kyang 1'chi/ skyabs gnas 2med/

lam rgyus 3med/ cis kyang4 mi bzlog /mgyogs par5 'gro/ gzur sa6 med/ shin tu nga 7bar 'gro dgos pa ste/ bdun ldan pas bsgom bya zhing : phan yon rgyud la dad 1pa skye/ bla ma la mos gus2 'byung*/ gdams ngag3 nges shes skye/ nyams len la 'jug4 nus/ stong nyid rtogs pa sla 5ba ste/ lnga ldan sgo nas 'bad: yul dang lus dang sems gsum la: skye bo mu stegs nyan rang gis: gang zag chos kyi bdag tu bzung : bdag 'dzin ma grub bdag med stong : rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal bzhi la gnas: (260)yan lag sdug bsngal drug la spyod: nying lag sdug bsngal bgrang las 'das: rang sems stong pa nyid du sprad: dge sdig gnyis kyis rgyu byas nas: 'bras bu bde sdug gnyis su 'byin: dge sdig so mtshams legs par dbye: sdig pa stobs chen sgo nas bshags: ༈ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la: nyan rang byang sems gsang sngags gsum: rang dang gzhan dang gnyis don du: skyabs 'gro rnam gsum 'das pa'i chos: sangs rgyas thob 'dod bsam pa'i don: sgrub cing nyams su len pa dang : chos nyid blo 'das 'dus ma byas: sems bskyed gsum yin theg chen chos: sdig pa rnam gsum mi bya zhing : dge ba rnam gsum spyad par bya: gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'o: sdom gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa yin: byams pa'i sems la zhe sdang med: snying rje'i sems la 'dod chags med: byang chub sems la gti mug med: sems gsum sangs rgyas thugs dgongs yin: gnod sbyor log pa tshul khrims te: phan 'dod zhugs pa ting 'dzin yin: thabs shes zung 'jug shes rab ste: bslab gsum sde snod gsum yin no: ༈ :rang byung ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi: rang bzhin skye med stong par gnas: rol pa 'gag med snang ba 'char: ngo bo gnyis med mtha' bral lo: ngo ma shes la log par brtags: nyon mongs lnga dang las gsum gyis: rigs drug lus blangs sdug bsngal myong : ma rig nas brtsam rga shis 'khor:

yin tshul cir yang ma nges pas: snang tshul cir yang 'char bar byed: snang tshad sems nyid rang snang yin: rang grol rtogs pa blta ba'o: so ma rang thangs lhug par bzhag: rtog med rang gsal rjen par 'char: snang sems dbyer med ngo bo gcig:(261)gsal stong dbyer med bsgom pa yin: rkyen snang phra rags mtho dman kun: rtog pa sems kyi cho 'phrul yin: zhum dang khengs pa med pa ru: zhen med rang grol spyod pa yin: gang byed rang so ngang la gnas: de yi ngo bo rang gsal ba: de ka stong pa nyid yin te: stong pa 'gag pa med pa yin: ma grub mi rtog mi 'gag pa: rnam dag lan grub bden gsum dang : lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu'i chos: shes bya kun ldan la zlo yin: ༈ :nges pa gzhi'i nges pa zad de gnas lugs mngon du gyur/ lam gyi nges pa zad de/ lam mthar phyin pa'o/ gnyis zad sku ru smin: ji lta ji snyed mkhyen gsum rgyas: rten can rten med ngo bo nyid: gcig dang du ma bral bar bzhugs: ༈ :dge ba 'di yi bsod nams kyis: nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams: yang dag don dang rab mjal nas: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog: rin chen spungs pa rdzogs so: ༈ /phyi bshad rin chen spungs pa'i bsdus don bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi bshad rin po che spungs pa 'di la don gsum ste/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung gi don dang*/ mjug gi don no// dang po la gnyis te/ phyag 'tshal ba bcom ldan 'das dpal dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o// de la bzhi ste/ shes bya la shes bya'i brtags pa dang*/ thar pa lam la 'jug thar pa'i sa dang*/ 'bras bu thob 'bras bu rnam mkhyen tshul/ man ngag gi mtshan rin chen spungs pa bstan pa'o// gnyis pa gzhung don la gsum/ drang don rgyud bskul gyi gdams pa dang*/ thun mong gi man ngag dang*/ khyad par rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams ngag go /dang po la drug ste/ bla ma bsten pa dang*/

dal 'byor brtag pa dang*/ mi (262) rtag pa bsgom tshul dang*/ bdag 'dzin gzhom pa dang*/ sdug bsngal bsam pa dang*/ rgyu 'bras dpyad pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid mtshan nyid drug dang*/ bsten thabs 'du shes bzhi dang*/ snod kyi mnyan tshul dang*/ mthong lugs sam bkur mthong lugs thabs so// gnyis pa dal 'byor brtags pa la bzhi/ dal 'byor dal 'byor mi lus ngos bzung ba dang*/ thob shin du dkon par dka' bar bsam pa dang*/ yal bar mi dor ba don med stong log dang*/ don yod par bya gtan gyi so nam ba'o// gsum pa mi rtag pa bsgom pa la bzhi/ phyi'i mi rtag phyi'i mi rtag pa lnga dang*/ nang gi mi rtag pa nang gi mi rtag gsum dang*/ tshul tshul bdun bstan ji ltar bsgom pa dang*/ phan yon gyi sgo phan yon lnga ldan nas 'bad pa'o/ /bzhi pa bdag 'dzin gzhom pa la bzhi/ gang la bdag yul dang dus dang tu 'dzin pa dang*/ gang gis skye bo mu stegs bdag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ ji ltar gang zag dang chos kyi bdag bdag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ bdag 'dzin bkag la bdag med bdag 'dzin ma grub du bstan pa'o// lnga pa sdug bsngal bsam pa la bzhi rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal bzhi bstan pa dang*/ yan lag gi sdug bsngal yan lag sdug bsngal drug bstan pa dang*/ nying lag gi sdug bsngal nying lag gi sdug bsngal grangs las 'das pa ra bstan pa/ sdug bsngal de dag sems su ngo sprad pa'o// drug pa rgyu 'bras dpyad pa la bzhi/ rgyu ngos dge sdig bzung ba dang*/ 'bras bu 'bras bu bde sdug skye tshul bstan pa/ dge sdig sa mtshams dbye ba dang*/ sdig pa sdig pa stobs bzhi bshags pa'o/ ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa thun mong spyi'i gdams ngag la lnga ste/ skyabs sangs rgyas chos dang*/ 'gro bya ba dang*/ sems pa sangs rgya thob 'dod bskyed pa/ (263)dang*/ sdom pa bzung ba dang*/ byang sems bsgom pa dang*/ bslab pa gsum la blo sbyong ba'o// gsum pa sdom pa bzung ba la gzhi/

so thar sdig pa rnam gsum sdom pa dang*/ byang sems dge ba rnam gsum sdom pa dang*/ gsang sngags gnas lugs rang kyi sdom pa dang*// sdom gsum sangs rgyas kyi sdom gsum sangs rgyas bstan par bstan pa'o// bzhi pa byang sems bsgom pa la bzhi/ byams pa byams pa'i sems dang*/ snying rje snying rje'i sems dang*/ byang chub kyi sems byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ de gsum sangs rgyas kyi thugs dgongs su bstan pa'o// lnga pa bslab pa sbyangs pa la bzhi/ lhag pa tshul khrims gnod sbyor legs kyi bslab pa dang*/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin phan 'dogs zhugs gyi bslab pa dang*/ lhag pa shes rab thabs shes gsum kyi bslab pa dang*/ bslab pa sde snod gsum de gsum sde snod gsum du bstan pa'o// spyi don gsum pa khyad par rang gi man ngag la gsum ste/ gzhi dang*/ lam dang*/ 'bras bu'o// dang po la gnyis te/ gnas lugs dang*/ 'khrul lugs so// gnas lugs la bzhi ste/ rang byung ngo rang byung ngo bo nyid bo nyid/ rang rang bzhin skye med bzhin skye med/ rol rol pa 'gags med pa 'gags med dang*/ ngo bo mtha' bral du bstan pa'o// 'khrul lugs la/ rgyu ngo ma shes dang*/ rkyen nyon mongs dang*/ 'bras bu rigs drug lus dang*/ 'khor tshul lo// gnyis pa lam gyi man ngag la lnga ste/ mtha' la mi gnas pa'i lta ba dang*/ rig pa rang lugs kyi bsgom pa dang*/ 'khrul pa rang grol gyi spyod pa/ 'gyur med gnad du btang ba dang*/ la zla'i man ngag go /dang po lta ba la bzhi ste/ gnas yin (264) tshul cir lugs dang*/ 'char snang tshul lugs dang*/ yin lugs dang*/ grol lugs so// gnyis pa bsgom pa la bzhi ste/ sems kyi bzhag so ma rang thabs dang*/ nyams kyi rtog med dang skye tshul dang*/ snang ba sems dbyer med du bsgom du ngo sprad pa dang*/ rtog pa bsgom du la bzla ba'o// gsum pa spyod pa la bzhi ste/ nyams rkyen snang snang ngos bzung ba/

de sems rtog pa la sems su bstan pa dang*/ ro snyoms zhum dang khengs pa dang*/ zhen med zhen med rang bskyang ba'o// bzhi pa lam gnad du btang ba la bzhi ste/ gnas pas gang byed so gzung ba dang*/ gsal de'i ngo bo bas mdangs 'don pa dang*/ stong par de ma stong rgyas gdab pa dang*/ dbyer stong pa 'gag med du gnad la dbab pa'o// lnga pa la bzla ba la bzhi ste/ gnas ma grub pa'i lugs ngo sprod pa de gzhi ru rnam dag lhun grub la bzla ba dang*/ lam de'i ngo bo dang 'bras bu la la bzla ba dang*/ shes bya shes bya kun ldan kun ldan du la bzla ba'o// gsum pa 'bras bu la bzhi ste/ rten nges pa gnyis sku bstan pa dang*/ rten ji lta ji snyed pa ye shes pa dang*/ 'gro rten cad rten don mdzad tshul dang*/ dgongs pa gcig dang du ma gzhug lugs so// mjug gi don la gnyis te/ dge dge ba 'di ba bsngo ba dang*/ mtshan rin chen spungs pa rdzogs tshul lo// phyi bshad rin chen spungs pa'i bsdus don rdzogs so// ༈ //nang bshad gsang sngags lam rim gyi lo rgyus bzhugs so// na mo ratna gu ru// gsang sngags lam rim 'di mdzad pa po slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas yin te/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis ces pas/ de ni sku che ba'i yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan zhing (265)man ngag rtsom pa'i tshad du phyin pa'o// dang po ni/ nub phyogs o rgyan du sku me tog padmo las brdzus nas byon nas mngal gyi sgrib g.yogs med de/ skye 'chi dbang du 'dus pas sku la 'das grong mi mnga' 'o// gsung gi che ba chos kyi sgo mo sna tshogs su ston cing ngag la nus pa thob pas dregs pa can thams cad bka' nyan pa la sogs pa'o// thugs kyi che bshes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus par mkhyen cing zag pa med pa'i dgongs pa dang ldan te rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa ni mkhyen pa gnyis dang ldan no// sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang ldan te/

dgos 'dod 'byung zhing re ba skong bas yon tan kyi che ba'o// nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad rang sar zhi// tshe dang nus pa phyogs med du rgyas te/ mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dbang du 'dus shing*/ log lta gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa ni phrin las kyi che ba'o// de dag ni che ba'i lo rgyus zur tsam brjod kyis/ rgyas par gzhan du blta'o// gnyis pa man ngag rtsom par mthar phyin pa ni/ rab chos nyid bden pa'i don mthong ba ste dngos po'i gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs pa'o// 'bring yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs pa ste longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i zhing khams mngon sum gzigs shing*/ yi dam thams cad kyi zhal mthong*// tha ma mtshan ma'i las la gnyer thob pa ste zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs pa med par grub bo// de lta bu'i bla ma sprul sku padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'o// gdams ngag rin po che gsal ba'i sgron ma 'di/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gshegs shul/ sde snod kun gyi lde mig /rgyud lung kun gyi snying po/ man ngag gnad kyi nying khu/ nges don gnad kyi ḍī ka /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs dgongs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam/ mun pa sel ba'i sgron me/ 'dzur sa med pa'i 'phrad (266)dgugs/ sangs rgyas lag tu gtod pa/ 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa/ gsang sngags lam gyi rim pa/ rin po che gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bgyi ba ston par bgyid do/ ༈ /gsang sngags lam gyi rim pa rin po che gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ mant+ra sya pa tha kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ gsang sngags lam gyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ rtsa ba gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis bcom gzung 'dzin gnyis ldan mkhyen pa gnyis rtag chad 'das gnyis gzhi dang 'bras bu'i dpal mchog / sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ma lus 'dus shing spyod yul yang dag grol 'khrul pa'i

med pa/ bcom ldan bde gshegs drug pa kun bzang la/ gus gdung dad pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor o rgyan pad 'byung gis// rdo rje theg pa tshe gcig thob byed lam// phyi rabs rnal 'byor las ldan don ched du// nyams len lam rim rin chen sgron me bri/ ༈ /gnas lugs 'khrul lugs ngo yis bzung ba ni: gnyis med lhun grub ka dag ye sangs rgyas: snying po ma rig las nyon log sdug bsngal: ༈ phun sum tshogs lngas bsgrub gzhi bzung ba ni: brag nag dur khrod phug sogs skyon yon brtsi: dad gus dbang dam shes rab gding dang ldan: tshes skar gza' bzang yar ngo'i snga gong 'jug: zas sman mchod skong sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams gsos: ma dred rtse gcig dka' thub mthar 'don no/ ༈ /rnal 'byor srung ba'i 'khor lo'i rim pa ni: lus can rnams kyis byang chub mchog thob bsgom: lha mtshan rdo rje 'khor lo'i mtshan mas bsrung : lus ngag sems (267)gsum sku gsung thugs yig bsam: spyan ras 'jam dpal gang yin yi dam bsgom: rdo rje sa ra gur dang mda' me bsgom: bya byed ngo bo mi dmigs ngang bzhag go: ༈ gnad lnga'i sgo nas lam la 'jug pa ni: thun mong khyad par bla med gsum skyabs 'gro: dkar dmar nag gsum brgya bzlas mchod dang bskang : dal 'byor las 'bras mi rtag nyes dmigs bsgom: sgrub dang mchod pa'i maṇḍal gnyis su 'bul: sna tshogs lam khyer gtor mas tshogs gnyis bsags: rgyun gtor gsum bdun bcu gcig la sogs btang : rnam dag bdun dang phyi nang gsang mchod dbul: de rnams gsang sngags lam gyi sngon 'gro yin: ༈ /bslab pa gsum la lam gzhi bca' ba ni: mi mthun spong sems mnyam 'jog rang ngo shes: shī la sa mā ti ṣikṣa ṇa: snod sbyor log zhugs khyad par thabs kyis zin: bden pa'i don mthong goms 'dris de mi 'da': gnyen po'i dbang gis brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs: sems gsum sgo nas lam la gzud pa ni:

yid 'ong pha mar shes shing bde ldan bsgom: sems can pha ma sdug bsngal bsgral bar bsam: sangs rgyas thob 'dod bsam pa len dang sgrub: sems gsum sde gsum bslab gsum nyams gsum thugs/ ༈ khyad par gsang sngags lam gyi ngo bo ni: bum gsang ye shes bde chen dbang bzhi bskur: ༈ phyi nang snod bcud gzhal yas lha ru bskyed: skye 'gags gnyis med rang byung mtha' las 'das: ༈ gnad gsum gcun pas rtog med rang gsal 'char: ༈ /so spyi bogs gsang yang dag kho na spyod: (268)༈ mnyam rjes bza' bcang bsrung ba'i dam lnga dbog: de rnams gsang sngags lam gyi ngo bo yin: ༈ rnal 'byor lnga yis nyams su blang ba ni: rtog med chos skur nyal la 'chi rtog sbyang : 'gag med longs skur langs te skye rtog sbyang : dbang bzhis bdud rtsir brlabs la bza' btung rol: sna tshogs thabs kyis bzung la lam du btang : drod srong skyes shar 'da' ka bar do bstim/ ༈ lam de'i gegs bzhi'i skyon bsal bstan pa ni: bying rgod nyams gsum bcos la lam du btang : nad kyi gzhi rgyu rkyen 'bras ngos bzung bcos: spros bral ngang bzhag rgyun chad skye dang sel: gnod pa'i zas bza' 'khrig bcad ltos med bskyur: dkar dmar nag po'i hūm̐ 'phros steng 'og gdon: rang las gzhan med ya nga khu 'phrig bcad: dam nyams grogs gnas zas kyi grib bzhi bsal: ༈ lam de'i bogs 'don gnad du gtong ba ni: skyon gyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin blo yis btang : yon tan gzhi ma nyams len drag po bya: rang gi lam la bogs med gzhan gyis 'don: nyon mongs gnad kyis gzung la lam du btang : rnam rtog lam du btang la bogs su 'don: de rnams lam gyi cha rkyen yan lag yin: ༈ lam de'i mthar phyin mngon gyur 'bras bu ni: sku lnga gsung lnga thugs yon phrin las lnga: rten can rten med ngo bo nyid don byed: gcig dang tha dad gnyis su med par bzhugs: gzigs tshul grub dang ma grub bden brdzun (269)brtag:

༈ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob byed nye ba'i lam: rang mtshan mngon du ston pa nges pa'i chos: thabs dang shes rab gnyis ldan shing rta'i srol: pham byed rgyal 'gyur bla med theg mchog go ༈ /'di sbyar dge ba dri med rnam dag gis: lus can thams cad smin grol lam zhugs te: rang chas shes rtog sgrib dag nyes zad nas: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog: gsang sngags lam gyi rim pa rin po che gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so: ༈ /nang chos gsang sngags lam rim sa bcad bzhugs so// dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo// nang bshad gsang sngags lam gyi rim pa 'di la don gsum ste/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung gi don dang*/ mjug gi don no// dang po la gnyis te/ phyag 'tshal ba

gnyis bcom gnyis ldan dang*/ rtsom par bdag nyid rnal 'byor dam bca' ba'o// gzhung don la gsum ste/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'o// gzhung gi spyi don dang po la gnyis te/ gnas lugs gnas lugs dang snying po 'khrul lugs so// gzhung gi spyi don gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lam gyi sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ lam rang gi ngo bo dang*/ lam gyi cha rkyen bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba dang*/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i rim pa bstan pa dang*/ gnad lnga'i sgo nas lam la 'jug par bstan pa'o// dang po la lnga ste/ gnas gang du dang phun sum tshogs/ dad gus gang zag gang gis dang*/ tshes skar dus gang la dang*/ ma dred rtse gcig rdzas gang bsags pa dang*/ thabs ji ltar (270)bsgrub pa'o// gnyis pa srung 'khor la drug ste/ byang chub sems rnal 'byor srung kyi srung ba dang*/ mtshon cha lha mtshams lnga'i srung ba dang*/ yi ge lus ngag yid gsum gyi srung ba dang*/ zhi drag gsum spyan ras brtsegs kyis srung ba dang*/ rang rdo rje ra ba byung lhun gyis grub pa'i srung ba dang*/ don bya byed dam mtshan ma med pa'i srung ba'o// gsum pa gnad lngas theg chen lam du 'jug pa la lnga ste/ skyabs gnas lnga'i 'gros chos kyi gzhi gting ba dang*/ yig dkar dmar nag brgyas sgrib pa sbyang ba dang*/ las dal 'byor las 'bras mi rtag pa sgom pa la blo sbyangs pa dang*/ maṇḍal sgrub dang mchod dang gtor ma btang sgrub dang mchod bas tshogs bsags pa dang*/ mchod pa phul la tshogs yongs su spel ba'o// gnyis pa lam rang gi ngo bo la gnyis te/ thun mong spyi yi lam dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lam mo// dang po la gnyis/ bslab pa gsum la lam gyi gzhi bca' ba dang sems gsum gyis lam gyi kha bsgyur ba'o// dang po la lnga ste/ ngo bo ngos bslab pa gsum bzung ba dang*/ mtshon bya'i shī la sgra don bshad pa dang*/ mtshan nyid

gnod sbyor log kyi rang ldog bstan pa dang*/ mtshan gzhi bden pa'i don skye tshul dang*/ gnyen po'i skye ba'am dbang gi sgo nas rnam grangs su 'gyur tshul lo// gnyis pa sems gsum gyis lam gyi bsgyur ba la bzhi ste/ byams sems gsum sgo gnyis pa dang*/ snying rje sems can dang*/ byang chub kyi sems sangs rgyas thob 'dod dang*/ de dag sde snod gsum sems gsum sde gsum du ngos bzung la bslab pa gsum bstan pa'o// gnyis pa gsang sngags rang gi lam la lnga ste/ khyad par rgyud smin par byed pa (271)dbang dang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa la lta ba dang*/ lta ba goms gnad gsum gcun par byed pa la bsgom pa dang*/ de dang mi 'bral zhing rtsal so spyi'i sogs sbyong ba la spyod pa dang*/ de dag las mnyam rjes bza' mi 'da' bar byed pa la dam tshig go /gnyis pa lta ba la gnyis te/ bskyed rim phyi nang snod sbyang ba dang*/ rdzogs rim skye 'gags gnyis bstan pa'o// gsum pa de'i cha rkyen bstan pa la gsum ste rnal 'byor lnga'i lam nyams len gyi gnad bstan pa dang*/ gegs sel bzhis lam gyi rkyen bsal ba dang*/ bogs 'don bzhis lam mthar 'don pa'o// dang po la lnga ste/ nyal ba'i rtog med rnal 'byor dang*/ ldang ba'i 'gag med rnal 'byor dang*/ za ba'i dbang bzhis rnal 'byor dang*/ sna tshogs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang*/ dus dro srod gnad kyi rnal 'byor ro// gnyis pa lam gyi gegs bsal ba la bzhi ste/ ting nge 'dzin nyams kyi bying rgod gegs bsal ba dang*/ lus na tsha sdug bsngal gyi nad kyi gegs bsal ba dang*/ sems rnam rtog lha 'dre'i rang las gzhan med gegs bsal ba dang*/ rkyen snang glo bur grib kyi gegs bsal ba'o// gsum pa lam gyi bogs 'don pa la gsum ste/ bogs lam de'i mi 'byung ba'i skyon bsal ba dang*/ 'byung ba'i yon tan gzhi bca' ba dang*/ bogs ji ltar 'don pa'i thabs so// de la gnyis te/

rang la gnas pa de la bogs 'don pa dang*/ sngar med gsar du skyes pa'i nyon mongs pa rnam rtog bogs su 'don pa'o// de la gnyis te/ nyon mongs bogs su 'don nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam rtog bogs su rnam rtog 'don pa'o// gzhung gi spyi don gsum pa nyams su blang nas mthar (272)phyin pa'i 'bras bu la bzhi ste/ lam de 'bras sku lnga chos ngos bzung ba dang*/ 'gro rten can don byed tshul dang*/ dgongs gcig dang pa la bzhugs lugs dang*/ gdul bya la thugs rjes 'dzin gzigs tshul tshul la gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa'o// spyi don gsum pa mjug gi don la gsum ste/ chos kyi che ba tshe 'dir bstan pa dang*/ 'di sbyar dge ba dge ba thams cad mkhyen par bsngo zhing*/ gsang sngags mtshan rdzogs tshul dang bcas pa bstan pa'o// nang bshad gsang sngags lam rim gyi bsdus don rdzogs so/ ༈ /gsang sngags lam rim gyi snying po sems nyid gcer ston lag khrid lnga pa bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i man ngag /sems nyid gcer ston gyi lag khrid 'di la lnga ste/ dang po rang sems lta ru gzhug pa/ gnyis pa ma mthong na sems ngo bstan pa/ gsum pa mthong ba'i don ngo sprod pa/ bzhi pa de'i rgyab skyor ba/ lnga pa la bzla ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi sems gang yin ltos la/ lan gcig khyer la shog byas pas/ sems stong pa nyid lta rgyu med pa gcig 'dug zer na ma mthong ba yin/ snang ba thams cad sems su 'dug zer na'ang sems kyi spyi rig tsam mthong ba yin gyis/ da lta ba'i rang sems ngos ma zin pa yin/ nam mkha' dang sa gzhi ri bo la sogs pa gang nas btsal yang mi rnyed do// gnyis pa sems ngo bstan pa ni/ sems kyi spyi rig tsam gyis mthong ba'i go mi chod do// da lta gang shar de ngos zin dgos pa yin/ da thabs sgra de sems su shar ba yin te/ ngas sems gang yin ltos shig byas pa khyod kyi sems su shar ba yin te/

khyod rang gang yin lta ba po de rang (273)sems yin no byas la/ ma dang bu'i dpes ngo sprad do// de yang sems la ltos shig ces pa'i sgra des sems la tshur bltas sam/ sems kyi sgra phar bzung ngam/ sgra sems dbyer med du 'dug ltos shig byas la dri/ snga ma gnyis po ltar zer na ma go ba yin/ dbyer med du 'dug zer na go ba yin pas ngo sprad par bya'o// de bzhin du gzugs la sogs pa yul lnga ka sems su ngo sprad do// gsum pa mthong ba'i don ngo sprod pa la gsum ste/ rnam pa rang grol/ gshis ye grol/ ngo bo gnyis med du sprad pa'o// dang po gang yin lta ba po'i sems de rang du 'dug gam/ gzhan du 'dug dri/ gzhan du 'dug zer na ma go ba yin/ rang du 'dug zer na ngo mthong ba yin pas ngo sprad do// gzhan ma yin par thag bcad la/ rang snang la gzhug pas rang grol shes 'gro ba yin no// rang du shes pas gzhan 'dzin gyi rtog pa mi skye ba ni rang grol gyi gnad yin no// gnyis pa ye grol ngo sprad pa ni/ lta ba ltar snang ba'i sems de snang ba rang rgyud du bden pa gcig 'dug gam ngo bo stong par 'dug dri/ rang rgyud du 'dug zer na ma go ba yin/ stong par 'dug zer na/ tshur bkug nas stong par 'dug gam/ yal ba'i rjes la stong par 'dug gam/ de ka rang stong par 'dug dri/ snga ma gnyis po ltar zer na ma go ba yin/ de ka rang stong par 'dug zer na/ ngo bo mthong ba yin pas ngo sprad do// snang ba rang rgyud pa bden pa min par thag bcad la stong pa nyid la gzhug pas ye grol shes 'gro ba yin no// stong par shes pas snang ba la bden 'dzin mi skye/ de ka ye grol gyi gnad yin no// gsum pa gnyis med ngo sprad pa ni/ stong pa cang med gcig 'dug gam/ gsal rig dang bcas pa gcig 'dug gam dri/ cang med gcig 'dug zer na ma go ba yin/ gsal rig can 'dug zer na stong (274)pa tha dad du 'dug gam/

gcig tu 'dug dri/ tha dad du 'dug zer na ma go ba yin/ gcig tu 'dug zer na ngo bo mthong ba yin pas ngo sprad de/ snang stong tha dad du med par gnyis med la gzhug pas gnyis med du ngo shes 'gro ba yin no// gnyis med la gnas pas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa mi skye/ de ka la gnyis med rtogs zer ba yin no// bzhi pa rgyab skyor la gsum ste/ rang grol gyi rgyab skyor ba rnam pa'i chos thams cad kyi gshis la ye yin ye grol la 'da' ba med de/ gser gling na gser/ chu gling na chu las 'da' ba med pa lta bu dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyab skyor ba la chos thams cad kyi ngo bo la gnyis med las 'das pa med de chu la gsher ba/ me la tsha ba las 'da' sa med pa lta bu ni/ lta ba'i skabs su shes par bya'o// lnga pa la bzla ba la gsum ste/ ka dag /lhun grub/ kun gyi bdag nyid du la bzla ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ sems kyi rtsal snang 'gag med du shar ba la gzhan gyi rtog pa ka nas dag pa ni/ ye shes ka dag /shar tshad kyi rang bzhin stong pa la dngos po rang rgyud kyis bden pa ka na dag pa ni dbyings ka dag /ngo bo snang stong gnyis med la tha dad kyi gnyis chos ka nas dag pa ni gnyis med ka dag go /gnyis pa lhan grub la gsum ste/ sems kyi rtsal snang sna tshogs su 'char ba la gzhan nas btsal mi dgos te/ sems rang shar ba ni chos can lhun grub/ shar tshad kyi rang bzhin stong pa las gzhan nas btsal mi dgos te shar ba po rang stong pa chos nyid lhun grub/ ngo bo snang stong gnyis med la btsal mi dgos te/ gang snang ba de dag rang gnyis su med pa ni gnyis med lhun grub bo// gsum pa kun gyi bdag nyid du gnas pa ni/ chos thams cad ni rang gi sems yin la/ sems kyi rnam (275)pa cir yang ma 'gags pa/ gshis cir yang ma grub ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa/ gzhi stong pa/ ngo bo cir yang mi rtog pa/ de chos thams cad kyi bdag nyid du/

de ka gzhi snang stong gnyis med kyi bdag nyid du bstan te/ rnam pa cir yang ma 'gags pa/ phyi snang ba gshis ci yang ma grub pa/ gzhi stong pa/ ngo bo cir yang mi rtog pa/ gzhi gnyis med kyi bdag nyid do// de ka lta ba bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi bdag nyid kyang yin te/ ma 'gag pa bskyed rim/ ma grub pa rdzogs rim/ mi rtog gnyis med do// bsgom pa zhi gnas lhag mthong gi bdag nyid kyang yin te/ ma 'gags pa lhag mthong*/ ma grub pa zhi gnas so// 'bras bu sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid kyang yin te/ ma 'gags pa longs sku/ ma grub pa chos sku/ mi rtog pa sprul sku'o// mkhyen pa gnyis ldan gyi ye shes kyang yin te/ ma 'gags pa ci snyed pa/ ma grub pa ci lta ba/ mi rtog pa gnyis med du mkhyen pa'o// spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa yang yin te/ ma 'gags pa rtogs pa ma grub pa spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'o// de ltar shes pas 'khor 'das skyon yon lha 'dre la sogs pa mnyam pa nyid du la bzla ba yin te/ snang ba ma 'gag par rang snang du mnyam/ ma grub pa stong par mnyam/ ngo bo mi rtog par gnyis med du mnyam mo// de tsam na snang tshad gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs/ lta ba bskyed rdzogs kyi yo langs/ sgom pa zhi gnas lhag mthong gi rang bzhin/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi dkyil 'khor las mi 'da' ste/ rang snang rang ngo shes nas gzhan snang gi rtog pa med/ rang stong rang ngo shes nas dngos po rang rgyud pa'i bden 'dzin bral/ gnyis med rang ngo shes nas tha dad gnyis 'dzin med/ (276)de tsam na stong pa rgyu 'bras su 'char ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos/ rgyu 'bras stong par rtogs pas mnyam pa nyid chen por la bzla'o// chos thams cad snang tsam du yod pa kun rdzob bden pa'i pho sgo/ bden med dngos su grub pa don dam bden pa'i rang gzhung*/ chos thams cad yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/

rtag pa yang ma yin/ chad pa yang ma yin/ skyon ye dag /yon tan ye rdzogs/ mtha' ye bral/ gnyis ma grub pa'i gnyis med/ zung ma rnyed pa'i zung 'jug /mtha' ma rnyed pa'i mtha' bral/ bzang ngan ma rnyed pa'i kun tu bzang po/ btsal mi dgos pa'i lhun grub/ 'khrul pa med pa'i ka dag go /bar lag thams cad rmings nas 'gyel/ 'gram rdo thams cad rtsad nas thon/ tham thum tham cad gcig tu 'dres/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gdod nas rnam par grol ba min pa gcig kyang med do// sems nyid gcer ston gyi lag khrid lnga pa/ gsang sngags lam gyi rim pa rin po che gsal ba'i sgron me'i khrid chung*/ ༈ /gsang sngags lam gyi rim pa'i don khrid ngo sprod du gdab pa rgad po mkhar tshugs dang rgan mo mdzub tshugs kyi gdams ngag bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la/ rngog shes rab rgyal po zhes bya ba lo drug cu lon pa/ thos pa ma byas pa dad pa ldan pa gcig gis brag po che'i dben rtsa ru/ slob dpon lo gcig bzhugs te/ rngog gis kyang chos zhu ma byas/ slob dpon gyis kyang chos bshad ma byas par/ lo gcig na slob dpon bzhud par dgongs pa la/ rngog gis gser srang gang gis maṇḍal gyi me tog byas nas/ slob dpon la phul te zhus pa// (277)slob dpon rin po che lags/ bdag la thugs brtse bar dgongs 'tshal/ bdag gcig tu thos pa chung*/ gnyis su shes rab chung*/ gsum du na so rgas/ slob dpon chen po bdag la go sla ba/ sgro 'dogs chod pa/ rtogs par sla ba/ lta khams che ba/ nyams su blang sla ba/ rgad po 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag gcig zhu 'tshal/ zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis rgad po'i snying gar phyag 'khar btsugs te gdams pa ni 'di'o// nyon cig rang rig byang chub kyi sems 'di la ltos dang*/ gzugs dang kha dog tu grub pa med/ phyogs dang ris su chad pa med/ mtha' dang dbus su grub pa med/ dang po byung ba med de stong*/

bar du gnas pa med de stong*/ tha ma 'gro sa med de stong*/ stong pa de ga ngo shes na/ rang ngo rang gis shes pa yin/ chos kyi chos nyid go ba yin/ sems kyis sems mthong ba yin/ dang po'i gnas lugs gtan la phebs pa yin/ rig pa byang chub kyi sems de dngos po cir yang ma grub cing*/ rang byung rang la gnas pas/ gzhan nas btsal du med de/ chos nyid don rtogs par sla/ chos nyid kyi don la re dogs kyis 'dzin pa med de/ sems rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das/ sangs rgya rgyu med de/ sangs rgyas rang gi sems/ dmyal bar 'gro rgyu med de/ dmyal ba rang gi sems/ sangs rgyas la re ba med de/ rang gis rang sangs rgyas/ dmyal bar dogs pa med de/ rig pa rang dag /chos la bya rgyu med de/ rig pa chos nyid rang gsal/ lta ba gnas lugs chen po rang la yod pas/ gzhan la btsal du med par thag bcad do// de ltar rtogs nas nyams su len par 'dod na/ rang gang na 'dug pa de lus ri bo'i dgon gnas yin pas/ (278)phyi snang ba la gang snang ba rang snang*/ gsal ba rang gsal/ stong pa rang stong*/ rang byung rang zhi/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar bzhag go /de nas phyi'i snang ba grogs su shar bas snang ba rang sar dag /rang sar dag pas snang ba lam du khyer nas nyams su blang bde'o// nang sems la dran pa ci shar ci 'gyus kyang*/ de'i ngang la ngo bo med de stong par 'dug pas 'gyu dran rang sar dag /sems la gsal thebs lam du slong bas nyams su blangs bde'o// gsang ba nyon mongs pa gang skyes kyang nyon mongs pa la bltas na rjes med do// rang byung rang zhi nyon mongs pa lam du khyer nas nyams su blang ba bde'o// de ltar nyams su lon tsa na/ sgom pa thun bsgom byar med/ thams cad grangs su shar nas nyams la gsal 'grib med/ chos nyid kyi ye shes la rgyun chad med/ spyod lam la spang blang med/ ji ltar 'dug kyang chos nyid kyi don dang 'du 'bral med de/

de ltar rtogs tsam na/ 'byung ba'i lus rgas kyang byang chub kyi sems la rgas rgyu med/ dbang po rno brtul med do// rnam rig gi rten lus zhig kyang*/ rig pa ye shes chos kyi sku la rgyun chad med pas mi 'gyur zhing brtan pa thob pas/ tshe la ring thung med do// chos nyid kyi don la phyogs ris med pas// don de go bas thos pa la che chung med do// rgad po yang dag pa'i lam de'i don nyams su longs mdzod cig /nyams len rgyud la 'khol mdzod/ tshig dang don du ma bral bar mdzod/ brtson 'grus kyi grogs dang ma bral bar mdzod/ dran pa'i rtsis zin par mdzod/ long gtam dang 'chal gtam la ma dga' bar mdzod/ tha mal gyi blo dang bral bar mdzod/ bu tsha bo la zhen pa ma che bar mdzod/ bza' btung la sred pa ma (279)che bar mdzod/ tha mal gshis la soms mdzod/ tshe la long med brtson 'grus bskyed mdzod/ rgas po 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag mdzod cig /gsung nas rgad po'i snying khar phyag 'khar btsugs nas gdams pas/ rngog shes rab rgyal po grub pa thob bo// rgad po 'khar btsug gi gdams pa sangs rgyas ngo sprod ces bya ba/ phyi rabs kyi don du mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gyis yi ger bkod pa'o// dge'o/ ༈ /na mo gu ru/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan drangs nas/ brag dmar na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ dad ldan bza' dge ldan ma zhes bya ba/ rgan mo dad pa che ba slob dpon la shin tu mos pa gcig yod pa des/ g.yog mo mar gong bza' rin chen mtsho zhes bya ba la nangs par chab zho zhal bu re la rgun 'brum gyi phye tshum re btab nas/ slob dpon la drang du btang ngo*// de nas slob dpon bsam yas su bzhud pa'i lam bar rgan mos phyag dang bskor ba byas nas zhus pa/ slob dpon chen po lags/ slob dpon ni bzhud kham/ rgan mo 'chi kham/ bdag gcig tu bud med kyi lus thob pas skye ba dman/

gnyis su blo dman pas shes rab dang thos pa chung*/ gsum du na so rgas shes pa rmugs nas mig mi gsal bas/ slob dpon chen pos rgan mo la tshegs chung ba go sla ba/ nyams su blang bde ba don che ba/ rgan mo 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag gcig zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas rgan mo khyod su yin gsungs pas/ rgan mos zhus pa/ khol mo ngan ma 'di nangs par gyi rigs la/ chab zho zhal bu re 'dren du btang ba de lags zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ khri srong lde'u btsan bas kyang dad pa (280)che ba gcig de yin ang gsungs nas/ rgan mo dpon g.yog la gdams pa btab pa/ rgan mo skyil krung chos la lus drang por bsrang la dar cig sems klod la zhog cig gsungs nas/ slob dpon gyis rgan mo'i snying gar mdzub mo btsugs te gdams pa btab pa ni 'di'o// rgan mo nyon mdzod cig /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi sems can gnyis la khyad ci yod byas na/ sems rtogs ma rtogs gnyis las med/ sems nyid kyi don rtogs pas sangs rgyas/ ma rtogs pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rang la yod kyang ngo ma shes pa yin/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu de sems can thams cad la yod/ sgos dal 'byor thob pa'i mi la yod de/ de yang skyes pa la sangs rgyas kyi rgyu che la/ bud med la sangs rgyas kyi rgyu chung ba med/ des na skye ba bud med du skyes kyang 'gal ba med do gsungs/ de la ye shes de rtogs shing shes par byed pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs kyang*/ de'i don shes par byed pa la bla ma'i gdams ngag gi tshig gsum du 'dus pas/ blo dman zhing shes rab chung yang mi ltos gsungs/ de ltar chos nyid kyi don sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa tshig gsum ni phyi gzung ba'i yul dag pas snang ba rang sar grol/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems dag pas 'dzin med kyi rig pa rang sar grol/

bar du 'od gsal nyams dga' nas rang ngo rang gis shes pa'o// de la phyi gzung ba'i yul ji ltar dag na/ rig pa byang chub kyi sems 'di la/ rnam rtog gi blos ma bslad par rang gsal du snang ba 'di la bzhag pas/ yul snang ba la 'dzin pa ma zhugs pas/ snang ba gang ltar yang don du bden par mi 'dzin te/ snang ba gang (281)yin sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal khyim dang mkhar/ nor dang 'bru/ dgra dang gnyen/ spun dang grogs/ bu dang khyo la sogs pa gang la'ang bdag tu 'dzin pa ma zhugs/ snang yang don du mi 'dzin cing zhen pa med pa de phyi gzung ba'i yul dag pa bya ba yin/ gzung ba'i yul dag pa zer na'ang med bzhin mi 'gro// zhen pa dang 'dzin pa med pa/ gsal la stong pa/ dper na me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang yang gzung rgyu dang 'dzin pa med de/ stong pa 'dra bas snang yang rang sar stong pa'o// nang 'dzin pa'i sems dag pas rig pa rang sar grol pa'i man ngag ni/ sems rnam rtog 'gyu byed kyi dran pa dang*/ dug lnga gang skyes kyang*/ gang dran pa de la blos ma bzung bas/ 'gyu ba rang sangs su 'gro bas stong ste/ 'gyu byed kyi skyon gyis ma gos pa'o// nang rig pa dri ma med pa zer nas/ bem po sa rdo ltar 'gro ba med/ rig pa la rtog pa'i dri mas ma 'dzin pa la zer ba yin/ dper na rin po che gser gling phyin pa 'dra/ gser gyi gling du phyin tsam na/ sa rdo'i ming yang med pa bzhin du/ rang rig pa'i ye shes su grol tsam na/ rnam rtog gi ming yang med pa yin gsungs/ bar du 'od gsal nyams dga' ba'i man ngag ni/ de nyams su blangs pa'i dus su rang rig pa dri ma med pa la sa le sang nge hrig ge ba de nyams su blangs pas bde ba gsal la mi rtog pa gsum/ zhen 'dzin dang blo yis ma bslad pa'i nyams gcig 'ong bas/ de sangs rgyas dgongs pa yin pas rang ngo rang gis shes pa'o// dper na rang gi yin pa la 'di ba'i yin ched du bsgom mi dgos/

ma yin snyam pa'i rnal 'byor rtog pa gang yang mi 'char ro// dpe de dang 'dra bar rang gi rig pa chos nyid yin par rang gis ngo shes tsam na/ (282)'khor ba'i chos thams cad chos nyid yin snyam du bsgom mi dgos/ ma bsgom kyang chos nyid kyi don dang mi 'bral te/ ma bsgom pa'i bsgom pa bya ba yin no// chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa de ye shes kyi bu/ rig pa chos kyi dbyings ngo shes pas rang ngo rang gis shes pa bya ba yin no// dus de tsam na skye ba la mtho dman med/ bya ba la che chung med/ blo la rno rtul med/ shes rab la che chung med/ thos pa la mang nyung med/ na so la rgas gzhon med/ shes pa la gsal mi gsal med/ tshegs chung la go sla ba/ nyams len bde la don che ba/ 'chi ba la nyams mi nga ba/ rgan mo de ltar nyams su len mdzod/ tshe la long med pas rtsol ba bskyed mdzod/ bu khyo'i khol por glag med lo stong byed pa las/ rig pa skad cig bsgom pas skyed che/ bla mas gdams pa'i brgyag myur tu thon/ tshe 'di'i bya ba la zin dus med pas sgom sgrub mthar phyung mdzod/ rgan mo 'chi kha mi 'tsher ba'i sun mar gdams pa 'di thong mdzod/ ces gsungs te rgan mo'i snying gar phyag mdzub btsugs nas gdams pa btab pas ming yang rgan mo mdzub btsug gi gdams pa zhes bya'o// rgan mo dpon g.yog gnyis grol te grub pa thob bo// phyi rabs kyi don du mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gyis yi ger bkod pa'o// rgan mo mdzub btsug gi gdams ngag rdzogs so// de ltar phyi nang gi lam gyi rim pa 'di dag slob dpon chen po padma saṃ bhā ba'i rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul med/ lo tsā ba gnyag dzñā na ku mā ra dang*/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes nas bka' ma'i brgyud pa bar ma chad pa dang*/ gter kha gong 'og gnyis dang*/ gter chen rdo rje gling pa bcas kyi gter byon rnams tshig don 'dre bar bzhugs pas shin tu yid ches pa'i gnas su bzung bar bya'o// 'di dag la rang 'grel (283)dang*/
gdams pa'i cha lag sogs kyang rgyas par bzhugs so// sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu/// /(284)
